subject: design/feature-draft-v1
statement: The lock approval is the operator's approving review of the draft pull request. Branch protection requires it: the operator owns the contract records a lock adds, so a lock needs the operator's code-owner review, with approvals dismissed when new commits arrive, approval of the latest push, and admins bound. A proposal that adds no contract records keeps today's merge policy, the merge lane included (`design:merge-lane-v1`; `design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design#D-20`). The lock reads the review through an approval port whose first adapter is the code host (`design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design#D-8`; `prd:feature-draft/FR-17`, `FR-46`, `FR-47`).
